description: A gray T‑shirt lies on a yellow tabletop against a white wall, with brown paper draped in the back corner. The right hand reaches forward to grab the crumpled shirt, lifts it while the left hand comes up to help spread it out, then both hands lay it flat and smooth it; the left hand folds one side inward and the right hand folds the opposite side inward, and finally both hands fold the bottom up into a neat rectangle and press it down, making the shirt a two-hand object during the main folding steps.
